published_prior_art.cite: CanenSong2026 gives uniform simplex-weight confidence sets; Andrews1999 supplies boundary extremum asymptotics.

Gunsilius2023 and SommerfeldMunk2018 supply adjacent discrete-transport ingredients, but no located result composes separately sampled endpoint noise with learned simplex-face weights and the stated two-sample phases; Chen2020 must nevertheless be added as a direct DSC comparator.
ChernozhukovFernandezValMellyWuthrich2020 gives generic simultaneous discrete-QE bands; the proposed DKW fallback is a conservative learned-weight composition rather than a new frontier by itself.
RobinsVanDerVaart2006 and HoffmannNickl2011 provide general honesty obstructions, not the stated DSC local-collision cutoff.
AndrewsMikusheva2016 and CoxShi2023 provide conditional/active-constraint ingredients, not this compound endpoint-and-cone cutoff.

No located publication supplies a uniformly honest, conditionally sharp certified procedure across both atomic-knot and simplex-face singularities; Chen2020 and AlvarezOrestes2024 are required direct DSC comparators.

novelty_flags.label: related_work and all DSC-facing theorem gaps
novelty_flags.one_line: Chen2020, a published direct distributional-synthetic-control method with pre-intervention quantile-residual matching, is omitted despite being a closer comparator than several included component papers.

soundness_flags.label: ass:local-knot-array
soundness_flags.one_line: The finite-versus-diverging knot-gap subsequence dichotomy is not a standard Fang--Santos condition; retag it as a derived subsequence extraction or a novel local-array restriction and justify its role.

soundness_flags.label: thm:three-phase-expansion
soundness_flags.one_line: Its finite-array uniform expansion uses d and Z, which are only subsequential limit objects, so it needs an ell-indexed endpoint-loss term and a separately stated local-subsequence convergence theorem.

soundness_flags.label: thm:oracle-common-cutoff
soundness_flags.one_line: Pr_theta and the admissible class of randomized radius rules are undefined, so the claimed minimax optimality must specify the finite Gaussian experiment and restrict the comparison to common deterministic conditional cutoffs or define a data-dependent decision criterion.

source_verification_receipts.version: Review of Economic Studies 86(1), 2019, version of record
source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 377-412, Abstract and Section 1, especially equations (1)-(2)
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies inference for a known directionally differentiable map of an estimable parameter and its Gaussian limit; it does not state a finite-support-knot clustering or finite-versus-diverging local-gap assumption.

source_verification_receipts.locator: article abstract and bibliographic record, pp. 1105-1117
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The version of record establishes DSC by replicating the treated quantile function with a weighted average of donor quantile functions. Its full Proposition 5 text was not accessible here, so no formula-level pooled-bridge comparison was treated as verified.

The paper explicitly supplies DSC inference under smooth empirical-quantile conditions and a dilution condition requiring oracle weights to spread across controls; its direct DSC inference contribution must be acknowledged.
The paper constructs an asymptotically uniformly valid confidence set for a simplex-valued optimizer weight, including binding simplex faces.
The paper derives finite-space empirical Wasserstein limits through a random linear-program value, including a two-sample null limit.
The paper develops simultaneous confidence bands for quantile and quantile-effect functions with possibly discrete outcomes by transforming simultaneous distribution-function bands.
The cited mosquito-abundance DSC application exists and analyzes heterogeneous IIT-SIT effects using trap-level abundance distributions.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of Applied Econometrics 35(5), 2020, version of record
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Chen proposes a distributional synthetic-control method based on matching pre-intervention quantile residuals and convex combinations of control counterparts under poor matching.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add Chen2020 to related work and state precisely why its residual-factor identification and inference setup neither yields the exact quantile-span model nor covers atomic endpoint collisions and simplex-face drift.
Replace the current global three-phase display by an ell-indexed exact endpoint functional, then state uniform bounds and local-subsequence weak limits separately with an explicit joint coupling.

Define the conditional Gaussian experiment, its theta-indexed probability law, the permitted decision-rule class, and a finite worked J=2, S=2 face-and-near-collision certification instance before claiming cutoff minimaxity or termination.

recommended_next_step: Revise the missing direct DSC survey comparison and the two ill-posed theorem statements, then re-submit with a source-located Proposition 5 comparison from the Gunsilius version of record.
